_about: The Build Pack's flow programme, for the Programme page. Status is worked out from Klaviyo at each refresh by matching flow names that start with the 'match' prefix. Edit this file (then redeploy) to update to-dos, answers or what each flow replaces. Sources: docs/source Build Pack (rollout plan, chapter 6 questions) and docs/03-build-log.md.

flows.note: Pack says edit the live welcome in place; on the Klaviyo route it is built as a new EG · draft instead (existing flows are never edited).
